status: PROVISIONAL -- the founder's clinicians confirm this wording, as they confirm the freshness thresholds (R-2026-09-23-67 A7, extended by R-2026-09-23-68 C3). Only a founder ruling on their answer removes this label.
comment: THE ONE TABLE of words shown in place of a code (R-2026-09-23-68 C), shared by the public page and, since R-2026-09-23-70 E, the ward console, so the two cannot disagree. Moved here from apps/public-dashboard/src/ by PR 3.4a. The public page never prints a raw code: every value of every enum the page receives is either given words here under `labels`, or named under `not_yet_displayed` with the reason it is not shown. tests/compliance/public_labels.test.ts derives those enums and their values from the migrations, and tests/db/public_labels_enum.test.ts from the database catalogue, so a value added to an enum turns both red until it is decided here. An empty string is a deliberate decision that the value adds no words to the line (OFFERED, ACTIVE, WARD, OK). A code the page receives that is not in this table renders the fallback and is logged, never shown. Words only the ward console shows (the zero reasons, the offering choice) live in ward-labels.json beside this file, because this table must cover EXACTLY what the public page receives.

displayed_since.status_source: R-2026-09-23-69 (b), built in PR 3.4a: an ADMIN count renders 'set by admin, not ward-confirmed' beside the count, as 002 section 6 requires, BEFORE any admin write can reach this page. v1 writes neither ADMIN nor UNDER_REVIEW, so this rendering is GUARD-AHEAD-OF-SUBJECT until an admin write path exists.
displayed_since.status_state: R-2026-09-23-69 (b), built in PR 3.4a: UNDER_REVIEW renders 'under review' beside the count (002 section 6). The wording is PROVISIONAL, like every word here.

phrases_note: THE PUBLIC PAGE'S OWN PHRASES (R-2026-10-09 GO, GO-4). Words only the public page speaks, kept OUTSIDE labels so the ward console, which reads labels through precedence(), never changes. A {name} is a slot the page fills (a count, a time, a place name); the page never fills one from text a visitor typed. Every phrase here is PROVISIONAL under the status above. Three groups were not in front of the clinicians when they signed off the band order and wording, and the founder confirms them with the clinicians before the merge word: aged_order; the null-count words (count_not_reported, last_known_not_reported); and the gated stale words (last_accepting, last_not_accepting, last_not_accepting_gated). The control labels, the no-match words and order_label are the build's own working words, listed in the pull request for the same confirmation.
